task.prompt:
# Task
Post URLs get too long. Add a maxLength option to slugify, so slugify(text, { maxLength }) returns a slug of at most maxLength characters that never ends with a hyphen and does not cut a word in half when it can avoid it.

Editable files: src/text/slug.js

# Files
## src/text/slug.js (EDITABLE)
```
/**
 * A URL slug: lowercase ASCII letters and digits separated by single hyphens.
 * Accents are dropped ("Café" -> "cafe"); anything else separates words.
 */
export function slugify(text) {
  return text
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, "")
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
}
```

Reply with the new contents of the files you change among: src/text/slug.js.
